US Supreme Court rejects Trump's bid to restrict mail-in ballots

The U.S. Supreme Court has rejected a bid by President Donald Trump to restrict mail-in ballots ahead of the midterm elections. The court's decision denied the Trump administration's plan to screen these ballots. Following the ruling, Trump expressed anger, criticizing the judges and calling the decision highly political. Several news outlets reported on the Supreme Court's action, noting it thwarted the President's efforts to limit postal voting.
